threshold_stage: after all applicable validated terms: fees, slippage, data-quality uncertainty, projection error and multiple-testing adjustments; uncalibrated diagnostics are not silently deducted
change_control: Keep 1.5pp for future runs unless the user explicitly changes it.
evidence_gate: Evidence eligibility is separate. Inapplicable models, unclear contracts, leakage, or unvalidated projections are SKIP_EVIDENCE_GATE rather than assigned a different edge threshold.

probability_fusion.directional_rule: p_trade = p_center - dynamic_uncertainty; construct coherent base distributions before evaluating Yes and No directions
probability_fusion.disagreement_policy: All internal/external and model-component disagreement measures remain diagnostic only; they do not widen uncertainty, lower p_trade, or trigger an automatic evidence-gate rejection.
probability_fusion.replaces: min(lower_external_probability, p_center) minus fixed source and selection buffers

execution.taker_cost: VWAP plus the per-market feeSchedule cost
execution.maker_cost: post-only limit price when maker fees are zero
execution.kelly_cost_basis: Use fee-adjusted effective cost for taker and limit price for maker.

source_freshness.oddschecker: Use the live market header with a captured timestamp; do not use stale odds repeated in static article text.
